calls.thesis: Messy Q3 but underlying profitability still growing: revenue up 26% YoY to $64.6B, a $9.89B legal charge suppressed operating income, free cash flow was negative this quarter (capex $34.91B vs operating cash flow $32.8B) and he expects negative FCF and some dilution from the new Class C share into 2027 — but he still thinks Meta is undervalued (updated DCF: 15% operating-cash-flow growth at 14x price/OCF gives ~17% annual compounding; ~23x normalised earnings if net margin returns to ~30%), so he continues holding and would increase the position if the shares come down more.
